content.text:
I'll ask you before I do anything. The page says to open the account at **"פסגות"** (Psagot) and buy the fund **"אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125 (4A)"**. It says I'd have **86,045 ₪** after 10 years.

I'm not sure about it, though, for three reasons:
- **The amounts aren't mine.** The page filled in 10,000 ₪ now and 500 ₪ a month by itself, so the 86,045 ₪ is for those numbers. I didn't change them. There's a box for each amount, but I didn't try them.
- **A minus sign right next to that fund.** It says "‎-0.04%‎ בשנה · שנה אחת". To me that looks like it went down last year, and that frightened me. I remember the fund the bank adviser sold me that fell.
- **Psagot isn't my bank.** I don't know them. My kind of names, like Leumi (82,968 ₪), Hapoalim and Discount, are lower on the list.

**What decided it:** Psagot was first on the list and marked with a star and "הזול" ("the cheapest"). It was the biggest number on the page.

**What I looked at, in order:**
1. **The top.** The title says "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד". Right away there were buttons with English letters: MSCI, S&P 500, and Nasdaq in Hebrew. I nearly left. "ת"א-125" was already chosen, and it said the money is in shekels and Israeli funds, so I stayed.
2. **The boxes and sliders.** There were boxes with 10,000 and 500 and a return of 7%. I didn't touch the sliders.
3. **The big box.** It said I put in 70,000 ₪ and would be left with 86,045 ₪. Next to it was another box with a minus: "‎-1,030 ₪".
4. **A coloured bar of costs.** The pink part said 5,555. I didn't understand the bar. I did read the legend under it: tax, account fees, "דמי משמרת".
5. **The list of banks and companies.** It goes from Psagot down to Meitav Trade at 63,151 ₪. Many rows had a note "לא בחישוב" (not in the calculation), saying there's a different price for soldiers, students and so on. One row said women over 60 have a different price, but "סגור למצטרפים" (closed to new people). I didn't open the little arrows.
6. **The fund's card.** It had a number, "5112628", and fees of 0.1% plus "נאמן 0.025%". Below that, the list of all the funds started. There I stopped.

**What I skipped:** I didn't touch the sliders or open the little arrows. I didn't read anything past the fund list. The pale grey line at the bottom of the cost box, "הפס נחתך", I couldn't really read.

**Words I didn't understand:**
- "MSCI World", "S&P 500", "(4A)"
- "דמי משמרת", "נאמן", "קרן מחקה", "תכלית סל", "העמלות זו על זו"
- "בכסף של היום" and "אינפלציה · לדוגמה של האתר". I didn't understand whether the 86,045 ₪ already counts rising prices.
- I don't understand how the account costs only 18 ₪ more, the fund 1,390 ₪ less, and I end up with 1,030 ₪ more.

**What bothered me:**
- The black screen with grey letters was tiring.
- Every number has dotted purple lines under it.
- There are many minus signs.
- By the sixth or seventh screen I was tired and stopped.
